host.label: Host
host.description: The hostname or IP address of your Raumfeld host: the one speaker that runs the Raumfeld system for all others (e.g. '192.168.1.50'). Filled in automatically when it can be found on the network.

port.label: Port
port.description: The port of the Raumfeld host webservice. Leave at the default unless you know it was changed.

discovered_host.label: Raumfeld host
discovered_host.description: Pick the Raumfeld system to add. Each system needs its own provider instance.

select_host.title: Choose a Raumfeld system
select_host.description: More than one Raumfeld host was found on your network.

user.title: Connect to your Raumfeld system
user.description: Enter how to reach your Raumfeld host.

errors.cannot_connect: Could not reach a Raumfeld host at this address. Check the hostname or IP address and the port, and that the host speaker is switched on.
errors.already_configured: This Raumfeld system is already set up in Music Assistant. Each system can only be added once - enter the host of a different Raumfeld system, or reconfigure the existing one instead.
